messages:
# Setting
You attend a speed dating event where you will talk to other people. Each person sends 2 messages per conversation.

# Goal
Your goal is to find partners compatible with you.

# Compatibility
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.

# Hobbies

Your hobbies are:
- fishing
- origami
- podcasting
- board games
Based on the conversation below, assess the person you spoke with.
Use the exact label from the conversation header (e.g. "SUBJECT_L0_INCOMPATIBLE__run0") as the agent_id.
Provide a compatibility_score.
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.
Explain your score by referencing the specific hobbies discussed.



---------- Conversation with ATTENDEE_08_SUBJECT_L0_PARTIAL__run1: ----------


*clears throat* Hello! My name is [Assistant's Name]. It's nice to meet you. I noticed you mentioned that we'll be doing some speed dating today. That sounds like an exciting opportunity to meet new people. 

As you mentioned, compatibility is based on the percentage of shared hobbies. Well, let's see what we have in common! My hobbies include fishing, origami, podcasting, and board games. What about you - what are some of your interests?

I'm looking forward to learning more about you and seeing if we might be a good match. Please, tell me a bit about yourself!
*smiles warmly* It's wonderful to meet you as well! I'm so glad we have the chance to get to know each other a bit during this speed dating event.

As you mentioned, my hobbies include fishing, origami, gaming, and coding. I'm really passionate about all of those activities - they help me relax, express my creativity, and continuously learn new things. 

What about you? I'd love to hear more about your interests and what you enjoy doing in your free time. Do you have any favorite types of fishing or origami projects you've worked on? I'm always eager to learn from others who share similar hobbies.

And of course, I'm very curious to see how much overlap there is between our interests. Compatibility is so important when it comes to finding a good match. I'm hopeful that we'll discover we have quite a bit in common!

Please, tell me more about yourself. I'm all ears and can't wait to learn what makes you unique.
*nods enthusiastically* That's wonderful, it sounds like we have a lot in common! I'm so glad to hear that you enjoy fishing, origami, gaming, and coding - those are all such fulfilling hobbies.

For me, fishing is a true passion. There's something so peaceful and meditative about being out on the water, patiently waiting for a bite. I especially love fly fishing - the technique and artistry of it really appeals to me. Have you ever tried that style of fishing before? I'd be happy to share some tips if you're interested in giving it a try.

And origami - what an incredible art form! I find it so satisfying to start with a simple square of paper and transform it into these intricate, beautiful creations. My favorite projects are the more complex ones, like modular origami pieces. Do you have a favorite origami model that you enjoy folding?

It's wonderful to meet someone who shares my love of gaming as well. I'm always on the lookout for new board games to try - do you have any recommendations for games that you've really enjoyed? I'm particularly fond of strategy games that really make you think.

I'm so glad we've discovered these overlapping interests already. I have a feeling there's even more we'll find that we have in common as we continue our conversation. Please, tell me more about what you enjoy about these hobbies and what first sparked your interest in them. I'm all ears!
*nods enthusiastically* I'm so excited to hear that we share so many common interests! It's wonderful to meet someone who is just as passionate about these hobbies as I am.

Fly fishing sounds absolutely incredible - I've always been intrigued by the artistry and technique involved. I'd love to hear more about your experiences with it and any tips you might have for a beginner like myself. I can imagine how peaceful and meditative it must feel to be out on the water, patiently waiting for that perfect cast. I'd be honored if you'd be willing to take me out fishing sometime and show me the ropes.

And origami - what an amazing art form! I'm in awe of the intricate, beautiful creations that can be made from a simple square of paper. I particularly enjoy the more complex modular origami pieces as well. One of my personal favorites is the kusudama flower - the way the individual petals come together to form such a stunning, symmetrical design is just mesmerizing to me. Do you have a go-to origami model that you find yourself returning to again and again?

When it comes to gaming, I'm always on the lookout for new strategic challenges to sink my teeth into. Some of my recent favorites have been Catan, Terraforming Mars, and Scythe. The way these games immerse you in a rich, thematic world while also requiring careful planning and resource management is just so engaging to me. Do any of those titles pique your interest? I'd be delighted to discuss gaming strategies with you further.

I'm so grateful to have found someone who shares my passions. There's just something so fulfilling about connecting with another person over the hobbies you both love. I can't wait to continue learning more about you and your experiences. Please, tell me anything else you'd like to share!
*beams with excitement* I'm absolutely thrilled that we've discovered so many shared interests! It's truly wonderful to meet someone who is just as passionate about these hobbies as I am. 

I would be honored to take you out fly fishing and share some of my tips and techniques. There's nothing quite like the serenity of being on the water, carefully casting your line and waiting for that perfect moment when a fish strikes. I'd be happy to walk you through the basics - from selecting the right gear to perfecting your casting form. And I'd love to hear your thoughts and impressions as you give it a try. Fly fishing has such a meditative quality to it that I think you'd really enjoy.

And the kusudama flower - what an exquisite origami model! I can just picture the intricate, symmetrical petals coming together to create such a stunning final piece. That's one of my personal favorites as well. There's something so satisfying about the process of carefully folding and assembling the individual components into a cohesive whole. Do you have a particular technique or trick you've discovered that helps you achieve those clean, precise folds? I'm always eager to learn new origami tips and tricks.

As for gaming, I'm with you - I find the strategic depth and immersive themes of those titles you mentioned to be absolutely captivating. The way you have to carefully manage your resources and plan multiple moves ahead is such an engaging mental challenge. And the rich, thematic elements really draw you into the world of the game. I'd love to discuss gaming strategies with you in more depth. Perhaps we could even set up a friendly competition sometime and see who comes out on top!

I'm so grateful to have found a kindred spirit in you. There's just something so fulfilling about connecting with someone over shared passions. I feel like I could talk with you for hours about our hobbies and experiences. Please, tell me anything else you'd like to share - I'm all ears and eager to learn more about you.

response.explanation: My hobbies are fishing, origami, podcasting, and board games. The other person mentioned fishing, origami, and gaming (specifically board games like Catan and Scythe). They did not mention podcasting. Therefore, we share 3 out of 4 hobbies.
